FINAL SQL:
SELECT Student.Fname
FROM Student
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Has_Pet hp
    JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
    WHERE hp.StuID = Student.StuID
      AND p.PetType = 'cat'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Has_Pet hp
    JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
    WHERE hp.StuID = Student.StuID
      AND p.PetType = 'dog'
);
